title: Polynomial order at the inverse of a normalized parameter
statement: Let K and F be fields with a K-algebra structure on F, and let s ∈ F be transcendental over K. Let v be an AlgebraicCurve.Place K F satisfying v.ord(s) = 1 and v.ord(c(s)) = 0 for every c ∈ K[T] not divisible by T. Then every nonzero a ∈ K[T] satisfies v.ord(a(s⁻¹)) = −(a.natDegree : ℤ).
lean_statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (s : F), Transcendental K s → ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, v.ord s = 1 → (∀ c : Polynomial K, ¬ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ∣ c → v.ord (Polynomial.aeval s c) = 0) → ∀ a : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → v.ord (Polynomial.aeval s⁻¹ a) = -(a.natDegree : ℤ)
